claim.text: the RNG peripheral's DATA register is mapped at offset 0xB0

note: Register-map support added this session, via a real CMSIS-SVD file (Espressif's official ESP32-C2 register description, see evals/fixtures/esp32c2_register_map_excerpt.svd's header for the exact fetch) rather than forcing it into Vivado's timing-report format, which genuinely carries no register/address data. 0xB0 is the real addressOffset stated in that file.
